short_description: Service requires prior authorization that was not on file
typical_resolution: Submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical notes within 90 days of service.

short_description: Provider is outside the plan network
typical_resolution: Request a network gap exception, or resubmit with documentation of an emergency.

short_description: Service is excluded under the member's plan
typical_resolution: Confirm the exclusion in the plan policy; appeal only with evidence of medical necessity.

short_description: Service not medically necessary per clinical policy
typical_resolution: Appeal with chart notes and failed-conservative-therapy documentation.

short_description: Specialist visit without a required PCP referral
typical_resolution: Obtain a backdated referral from the PCP where the plan permits it.

short_description: Duplicate of a previously adjudicated claim
typical_resolution: No appeal required; the original claim stands.

short_description: Member was not enrolled on the date of service
typical_resolution: Provide proof of enrollment or correct the date of service.

short_description: Claim received after the timely filing deadline
typical_resolution: Appeal only with proof of timely original submission.

short_description: Procedure code invalid, unbundled, or inconsistent with diagnosis
typical_resolution: Provider corrects and resubmits as a replacement claim.

short_description: Drug is not on the plan formulary
typical_resolution: Request a formulary exception with a prescriber statement.
